Paladin · Theorycraft

Holy Line Blessed Shield Paladin

ranged Holy caster

Paladin theorycraft unchanged ranged Holy caster confidence low PTR

Last verified 2026-08-09 • Season 15 (PTR)

Move on when[ptr] Level 70 (Mrak, on the PTR) and the redesigned Judgement read and written down.
Move on when[ptr] A measured comparison against paladin-hybrid-shield-charge-holy on the same character.
Move on when[ptr] The comparison is done and the Holy line is worth building around. If Judgement's redesign turned out to be small, say so and play the hybrid instead.

Skill bar

1Clash
2Blessed Shield
3Defiance Aura
4Holy Bolt
5Fanaticism Aura
6Fortress

Rotation

[ptr] Auras up, Clash for Resolve, Blessed Shield as the main cast, Holy Bolt on cooldown - and go and read what the redesigned Judgement actually does, because that sentence does not exist anywhere yet and this whole page is waiting on it.

Skill point priority

  1. [ptr] Blessed Shield first - it is one of the three Holy skills 3.2.0 touches and it is the only one that can carry a bar
  2. Both auras next: Fanaticism Aura is where Vulnerable, Weaken and Fortify come from and gives 14% critical strike chance at 15 ranks
  3. Holy Bolt on the bar from the start - it is the second of the three Holy skills 3.2.0 adjusts and, unlike Judgement, it exists as a node in this repo's pinned 3.1.0 game database, so the site can actually draw it. Judgement is discussed everywhere on this page and appears on no bar for exactly that reason: the feed carries no Paladin skill by that name, and putting one there would name a node that resolves to nothing
  4. Clash for Resolve, Fortress for Unstoppable

Rotation

[ptr] Blessed Shield held down, Holy Bolt on cooldown, Clash for Resolve, auras up. Measure Blessed Shield against the Thorns build here rather than at the end, and slot Judgement in place of Holy Bolt in game to compare the two.

Skill point priority

  1. [ptr] Blessed Shield maxed; both auras maxed
  2. Holy Bolt ranked as the second Holy skill. Judgement would be ranked here too if this repo's game database carried it; it does not, so the honest thing is to leave the bar as it is and rank Judgement by hand in game once you have read the redesign
  3. Resolve to 30 by the base build's arithmetic, because Mantle of the Grey still pays per Resolve consumed
  4. [ptr] Strength for the +30% scalar

Summary

PTR - subject to change before Season 15 launches; every claim here is 3.2.0 test-build data and must be re-verified at launch. [ptr] Untested theorycraft with low confidence, and the reason for the low confidence is simple: 3.2.0's Paladin section describes its Holy-line changes without publishing a single number. Holy Bolt is adjusted, Blessed Shield is adjusted, Judgement is redesigned - that is the whole of it, in every source consulted. The argument for building around them anyway is that they are, together with the +30% core-stat scalar, literally everything 3.2.0 gives the class, and the class's carried-forward build collects none of them. A patch that redesigns a skill is usually telling you where it wants the class to go. This page takes that hint and builds the Holy character, on the understanding that it is a hint rather than a number. If the redesigned Judgement is weak, this build is weak, and no amount of gearing fixes it.

Reasoning

Hypothesis[ptr] 3.2.0's Holy-line work is where Paladin's 3.2.0 build is meant to be. The patch gives the class exactly two things - a +30% core-stat scalar and adjustments to Holy Bolt, Blessed Shield and a redesigned Judgement - and the class's existing build, Shield Charge Thorns, collects only the first. A build whose damage runs through the Holy skills collects both. The Resolve engine, the auras and the block package all carry over unchanged, because 3.2.0 does not touch Resolve, Retribution, Clash, Fortress or either aura, so the change is confined to the delivery skills.
Confidencelow
How to test it[ptr] (1) Read the redesigned Judgement in game and write down what it actually does. No source publishes it and the entire build hangs off it; everything below is provisional until that sentence exists. (2) Measure Blessed Shield's damage against Shield Charge's Thorns on the same character - Paladin's damage on this class's published build is Physical Thorns delivered by Retribution pulses, not weapon hits, so a Holy build is a different damage type as well as a different skill and the two may not be comparable at all. (3) Check whether Seal of the Second Trumpet's Judgement damage - already raised from 80-100% to 100-150% back in 3.1.x - survived the redesign, since a redesigned skill can silently invalidate a unique built for the old one. (4) Confirm the Resolve engine still works when Shield Charge is off the bar: Resolve comes from Defiance Aura plus Clash, and Clash stays, so it should. (5) Compare against paladin-hybrid-shield-charge-holy, which is the conservative version of the same idea and keeps the Thorns engine.
